QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`, those are mutex-wrapped variants (`buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed` / `buffer_alloc_free_mutexed`, lines 541-563).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the init function (`memory_buffer_alloc_init`) installs mutex-wrapped calloc/free variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on. It doesn't say outright that the plain pair is used otherwise, or that the choice is made at compile time, but both are implied by the `#if`-style conditioning.
